string.text: RAM Trim
Run full GC at level changes and loads
Frees Lua heap garbage before the next level loads. Only affects Lua memory, not engine memory.
Also run GC periodically during gameplay
A full GC can cause a brief hitch. Lower the frequency if you notice stutter.
Gameplay GC interval (seconds)
Tune Lua garbage collector
Makes the background collector start sooner so the Lua heap stays closer to its live size. Work is spread across frames, so no hitch. Unticking restores Lua defaults (200 / 200).
GC pause (lower = less memory, more CPU)
How much the heap may grow before a new collection cycle starts. 200 = wait until it doubles (Lua default). 150 = start at 1.5x.
GC step multiplier (higher = faster cycles)
How much work each incremental GC step does. Lua default is 200.
Engine: clear models on level unload

Sets r__clear_models_on_unload on. Frees cached models at level change so RAM does not build up across transitions. Loads may be slightly longer. Unticking reverts it only if this mod turned it on this session.
Engine: do not keep textures in RAM

Sets r__no_ram_textures on. Avoids keeping a system-RAM copy of textures already on the GPU. Biggest potential saving. Takes effect for textures loaded afterwards; restart the game for full effect. Unticking reverts it only if this mod turned it on this session.
Log heap report at load and level change
Logs the largest Lua tables per script module, to find addons holding lots of memory. Estimates only. Can add a short delay to loads; turn off when done.
Log Lua heap size to the game log
Writes [ram_trim] lines to the log so you can see how much memory was freed.
